# Self_Healing_Polymers

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
Polymer composites that can autonomously repair damage, extending the lifespan of printed structures. Could improve reliability of physical substrates for TCC/iNEST devices, reducing maintenance in embedded or distributed computing systems.
